events.ugraksChallenge.body.template: Ugrak challenges the realm to a duel at {hex} on {date}: {companies} companies a side. Win: Orc Respect +{respect}. Lose: {tribute} tribute.

events.grandAuction.body.template: Neutral villages at sealed auction: hexes {hexes}. Bids close at the next week close. Trust applies.

events.deepCall.body.template: Until {date} the Dwarf may make conquest attempts on hexes {reach} away from its land.

events.beastSurge.body.template: Until {date}: neutral beast garrisons +{garrison}%, and beasts bring {share}% of daily threats.

events.hungryWinter.body.template: Until {date}: tithes −{tithes}%, and every village's loyalty −{loyalty}%.

events.dragonWakes.body.template: The Dragon attacks {hex} on {date} in a Grand Battle. Win: the Dragon's Heart and {reputation} reputation.

events.wildHunt.body.template: The Wild Hunt attacks {hex} on {date} in a Grand Battle.

events.pretender.body.template: A rebel host rises in the old lands of the {rival} and seizes hexes {hexes}.

events.fearOfTheCrown.body.template: Until {date}, every rival spends more on armies.

events.villageUprising.body.template: The village at {hex} turns neutral on {date} unless {cost} is paid.

events.wanderingOrder.body.template: A company of power {power}, {tags}, serves the realm until {date}.

events.lostHeir.body.template: {rival} offers a marriage pact: its Accord opens at Respect {respect}.

events.envoys.body.template: {rival} asks to borrow one company on {date}. Lending it: Respect +{gain} with {rival}, −{loss} with {foe}.
